title: Fix .env → os.environ propagation
prompt: packages/core/src/agent_debate/core/settings.py loads .env into the pydantic-settings Settings model (via SettingsConfigDict(env_file=".env")). This correctly populates settings.anthropic_api_key, settings.rounds, etc. BUT: pydantic-ai's Anthropic provider reads the key from os.environ["ANTHROPIC_API_KEY"] directly — not from the Settings object. So if the user only has the key in .env (not set as an OS env var), the Anthropic provider raises "Set the ANTHROPIC_API_KEY environment variable". Fix: in get_settings(), after constructing Settings, export non-None api key values back to os.environ via os.environ.setdefault() so downstream libraries that read os.environ directly can find them, without overwriting explicit shell-level overrides.
